metadata.title: SUBDIVISION BLUEPRINT & CADASTRAL QQQ RELATIONSHIP DISCOVERY

classification_definitions.DOCUMENTED_RELATION: Directly supported by an independent public/documentary record linking the specific cadastral QQQ to the subdivision block name/letter.
classification_definitions.LOCAL_EMPIRICAL_ASSOCIATION: Observed empirical co-occurrence within an audited micro-area without independent external documentary proof.
classification_definitions.HYPOTHESIS_TO_VERIFY: Structural hypothesis regarding universal mapping across the municipality.
